profileEvidence.summary: Friendly and close to people in its breed standard, the French White and Black Hound is valued in deer hunts for a fine nose, a carrying voice and diligent trail work. Its modern type developed from Saintonge stock during the nineteenth century, with later Poitevin and Gascon Saintongeois crosses. It gained a standard in 1957.
